trialSpd2Supplements.method: spd2 conversion identical to the production yardstick (shadow_v8.build_speed_adjusted over the same speed pool gen_chain.py used): par = median of all pool race times at (track, surface, distance) dated strictly before the trial date (>= 5 samples); raw = trial_time - par; when the trial day's own variant stands, value = raw - variant (form=variant-adjusted), otherwise value = raw (form=raw-no-variant). spd2_recent = spd2_best = the single trial value. Elo is never derived from trials.
trialSpd2Supplements.principles: pass rows of official ability trials only （能力試験/能力検査/能力審査）; conversion only where races exist at the same track/surface/distance; unfound or unconvertible horses stay unsupplemented and are listed with reasons; JRA first starters out of scope (no ability-trial system); banei excluded
